name: STMPS2151STR power distribution switch
description: STMicroelectronics STMPS2151STR, a 500 mA P-channel high-side power distribution switch for USB with an active-high enable and an open-drain fault output, in SOT23-5: the NUCLEO-144's (MB1137) U12, which powers CN13's VBUS from +5V when the MCU drives PG6 (USB_PowerSwitchOn) high, for the OTG core's host mode.

pins.name: FAULT
pins.doc: Open-drain, active-low over-current and over-temperature flag (SOT23-5 pin 3): never asserted here, its off-state leakage a 1 GOhm path to GND

pins.name: EN
pins.doc: Active-high enable (SOT23-5 pin 4): logic high (above about 2 V) turns the switch on

pins.name: IN
pins.doc: Input (SOT23-5 pin 5): the supply, 2.7 to 5.5 V

functional.claims: Pins only: the functional policy has no supply voltages.

electrical.claims: The switch between IN and OUT, on while EN is high (an internal N-channel stage pulls the P-channel switch's gate to ground) and off while EN is low (the gate pulled to IN), as a P-channel MOSFET of about 90 mOhm with 5 V on IN; EN draws no current.
omissions: the datasheet was not at hand (ST's site refused the download): the on-resistance (about 90 mOhm), EN's threshold (about 1 V, within the logic levels of 0.8 and 2 V) and the pinout are taken from memory, not checked
the current limit (about 0.8 A), the thermal shutdown and the fault output with its deglitch (FAULT never asserts)
the under-voltage lock-out, reverse-current blocking and the body diode
the turn-on and turn-off slew and the supply current

sources.title: MB1137 B-01 electrical schematics (NUCLEO-XXXXZX), USB OTG sheet: U12 STMPS2151STR from +5V to USB_VBUS, EN on PG6 (USB_PowerSwitchOn) with R72's pull-down, FAULT to PG7 (USB_OverCurrent) through JP4 with R71's pull-up and LD7
